newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Another Red Terror trial opens in Ethiopia.
newsitem.headline: Another Red Terror trial opens in Ethiopia.

text.p: The trial of 121 people charged with genocide and murder during the 1970s Red Terror campaign in Ethiopia began on Friday, the fourth such trial to open in three weeks.

So far trials have begun for some 400 of the 1,200 people accused of involvement in the campaign launched by ousted dictator Mengistu Haile Mariam in 1977-78 to eliminate opponents. But many of the accused are on trial in absentia.
In another Addis Ababa courtroom on Friday, prosecutors charged 73 people with shooting to death 25 prisoners during the Red Terror, in which thousands of people were killed in the capital.
The government has charged 5,198 people with war crimes, aggravated homicide and genocide. Of these 1,200 are suspected of involvement in the Red Terror under Mengistu.
He fled after being ousted in May 1991 and lives in exile in Zimbabwe. He is among 25 former Dergue officials being tried in absentia in Addis Ababa accused of genocide and crimes against humanity.
